name: vscode-markdown-workbench
description: Plugin-based Markdown Live Preview for VS Code.

commands.title: Use Markdown Workbench for Markdown in This Workspace

markdownWorkbench.plugins.agentBridge.en.description: Copy selected text with a link to its saved source lines, for an agent.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.autoPair.enabl.description: Auto pair in the Markdown editor.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.backlinks.enab.description: Backlinks view and status bar count for the active note, with unlinked mentions.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.callouts.enabl.description: Render callouts and remember their disclosure state per panel.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.codeBlocks.ena.description: Highlight rendered and editable code fences; copy code.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.diagrams.enabl.description: Render Mermaid diagrams in strict mode.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.embeds.enabled.description: Transclude notes, images and media; open attachment cards.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.footnotes.enab.description: Footnote references, definitions, previews and navigation.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.indentGuides.e.description: Indentation guides in the Markdown editor.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.inlineTitle.en.description: Show and rename the note title above its Markdown content.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.lineNumbers.en.description: Line numbers in the Markdown editor, laid out like VS Code's text editor and following editor.lineNumbers.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.linkUpdates.en.description: Update links in other notes when a note or attachment is renamed or moved in VS Code.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.onlineVideos.e.description: Show YouTube and Bilibili links embedded as images as video cards, with titles and covers in trusted workspaces.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.outgoingLinks..description: Outgoing links view: the notes and files the active note links to, and links not created yet.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.outline.enable.description: Outline view of the active note's headings, following the caret. VS Code's own Outline covers the text editor.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.pagePreview.en.description: Preview internal links with a modifier hover or keyboard.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.pasteHtml.enab.description: Convert rich clipboard HTML into Markdown in notes and table cells.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.properties.ena.description: Edit YAML properties as typed fields, lists and ordered rows.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.quickSwitcher..description: Find a note by name, alias or path, or create it, like Obsidian's quick switcher.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.search.enabled.description: Render query blocks as live vault search results.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.smartLists.ena.description: Smart lists in the Markdown editor.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.suggest.enable.description: Complete links, headings, blocks and tags from the vault index.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.tables.enabled.description: Edit Markdown tables as grids with projected cell editing.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.tags.enabled.description: Render tags, find notes with matching hierarchical tags, and list the vault's tags in the Tags view.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.wordCount.enab.description: Word and character count of the active note, or of the selection, in the status bar.

markdownWorkbench.editor.fontSize.description: Font size of the note text in pixels (Obsidian's default is 16). Headings, code, tables, line numbers, properties and footnotes scale with it. It replaces editor.fontSize for notes; the font family still follows editor.fontFamily.

markdownWorkbench.editor.lineHeight.description: Line height of the note text as a multiple of its font size (Obsidian's default is 1.5). It replaces editor.lineHeight for notes.

markdownWorkbench.linkUpdates.mode.description: Obsidian's Automatically update internal links: `prompt` asks before rewriting links in other notes when a file is renamed or moved.

markdownWorkbench.files.newNoteFolder.description: New notes: empty for vault root, . for current folder, or a vault-relative path.

markdownWorkbench.files.attachmentFolder.description: Attachment destination policy: empty for vault root, . for current folder, or ./sub. Rich HTML paste keeps links and does not import files.

markdownWorkbench.onlineVideos.bilibiliP.description: Offer **Play here** on Bilibili cards in trusted workspaces. Off by default: Bilibili's player does not play inside VS Code's webview.

markdownWorkbench.tags.viewSort.description: Order of the Tags view: `name` (A to Z) or `frequency` (most notes first).

markdownWorkbench.tags.viewNested.description: Show nested tags (`#a/b`) under their parent in the Tags view, rather than as a flat list.

markdownWorkbench.vault.rootMarkers.description: A folder containing one of these entries is a vault root; without one, the workspace folder is the vault.

markdownWorkbench.vault.excludedFiles.description: Obsidian's Excluded files: path prefixes such as `Archive/`, or globs such as `**/*.excalidraw.md`. Excluded files stay linkable but are left out of the quick switcher, suggestions, search and unlinked mentions.

enumDescriptions: The editor's own chat (Cursor, or VS Code with a chat extension such as Copilot Chat) when it is the only agent installed; with Claude Code or Codex installed too, only copy, to paste into the agent you use.
Cursor's agent chat, with the passage on the clipboard to paste.
VS Code's chat, with the passage typed in.
Claude Code: a new conversation with the passage typed in.
Codex: the passage attached to the thread as a file.
markdownWorkbench.copyLinkForAgent.targe.markdownDescription: Which chat **Copy Link for Agent** opens after copying the link and passage. Extensions cannot see which agent you are working in, so `auto` only opens a chat when the editor's own chat is the only agent; pick one here to send the passage to it.

markdownWorkbench.debug.logging.description: Log plugin load/stop timings and debug messages in the Markdown Workbench output channel.

markdownWorkbench.plugins.external.description: External host plugin enablement by registered plugin ID.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Remote content and external code processors are disabled.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/host && tsc -p src/webview && tsc -p src/plugins/tsconfig.host.json && tsc -p src/plugins/tsconfig.webview.json && tsc -p src/workers && tsc -p test
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm contributions --check
scripts.check:full: pnpm check && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:vscode
scripts.package: pnpm build && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --check && vsce package --no-dependencies --no-rewrite-relative-links
